name: Temptation -Saiin no Naraku-
source:
A male student Yu has a special ability to hypnotize people by using his mysterious eyes and voice. Yu has set his eyes on a beautiful chick Kirihara Mana, recently transferred to the school......

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE024153.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
男学生神明悠拥有一种特殊能力，可以通过神秘的双眼与声音催眠别人。悠把目标锁定在最近刚刚转学而来的美少女桐原舞奈身上……

[译自 [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE024153.html]DLsite English[/url]]
